title: Chapter 457 - 457 Arrival; Preaching! (2)
content:
Chapter 457 - 457 Arrival; Preaching! (2)

Chapter 457 - 457 Arrival; Preaching! (2)

457 Arrival; Preaching! (2)

Not to mention that Lin Fan had a supreme status at Jiangbei University.

If he was willing to go, it would at least raise the standard of this corporate meeting by a level!

Also, according to what Song Keling knew, Lin Fan was also a major shareholder of Dahua Group and Yadi Automobile.

If Lin Fan was willing to help, he would definitely be able to solve a large number of job opportunities at Jiangbei University.

Zheng Cong and Wang Haoran thought that Song Keling was happy because they had agreed to go over now.

Then, the few of them walked toward the lecture hall.

…

Meanwhile, in Jingbei.

A man in a white shirt knocked on the door in front of him anxiously.

“Please come in,” an old man with a straight face said in a clear voice.

The man in the white shirt hurriedly walked in.

He sorted out his mind and said in a calm tone, “Leader, according to our intelligence network, a plane carrying the chairmen of Aven Group, United Group, Datong Group, Nanguo Industry Group, Liwa Group, Baojia Group, William Group, Wall Group, and Ye Xiu are about to arrive at Jiangbei International Airport!”

He said hundreds of names in a row.

Even the old man with a straight face and a determined expression showed a hint of surprise when he heard these people’s names.

One had to know…

These were not ordinary people but the leaders of major companies!

Their wealth was comparable to that of some medium-sized countries!

Now, they had gathered together and boarded a private plane to arrive in Jiangbei, Hua Nation?

Wait a minute!

Ye Xiu?

Jiangbei?

The old man quickly thought of something and said, “I understand.”

The man in the white shirt was stunned.

What did he know?

However, he did not dare to say anything more and said respectfully, “Alright.”

Then, he slowly walked outside.

The old man pondered for a moment before dialing a number from Jiang Province.

The call was quickly picked up.

“Jiangbei International Airport will soon welcome a large group of entrepreneurs, including Ye Xiu, the chairmen of Aven Group, United Group, Datong Group, Nanguo Industry Group, and so on.”

“Yes, Sir!”

An extremely excited yet solemn voice came from the phone.

On one hand, it was because Jiangbei City was going to welcome so many entrepreneurs.

On the other hand, it was because of this phone call!

He never thought that he would receive a call from this old man one day!

…

In just a few minutes…

Audis and Jeeps rushed toward Jiangbei International Airport like a sea of carps crossing the river.

At this moment, a luxurious private plane slowly landed.

Ye Xiu and the big shots who often appeared on the major news and financial media walked down one after another.

Ye Xiu, who was walking at the front, took a deep breath and took out his phone to make a call.

After a while, the call went through.

“Sect Master, I’ve brought the core members of my sect to Jiangbei. I wonder when I can pay you a visit?” Ye Xiu said respectfully.

Back in Modu, Ye Xiu had already told Lin Fan about the businesses and forces that the Qing Hong Sect controlled.

However, Ye Xiu felt that he was lacking in sincerity by not bringing them to meet Lin Fan personally.

After all, even if it were a group of dogs, he should let them meet their owner.

Otherwise, if they met the sect master in the future but did not recognize him, what should he do?

Therefore, he asked Lin Fan for his opinion a few days ago.

Lin Fan, who had just arrived at the lecture hall, was stunned when he received Ye Xiu’s call.

He did not expect Ye Xiu to bring those people to Jiangbei so quickly.

After a while, Lin Fan said, “Since you’re already here, then come over. I’m in Lecture Hall 3 of Jiangbei University.”

“I understand,” Ye Xiu replied respectfully.

As soon as he hung up the phone, a large number of Audis and Jeeps arrived at the airport.

A large group of men in white shirts and camouflage uniforms walked out.

They hurriedly stood in a line and shouted in unison, “Welcome to Jiangbei, entrepreneurs!”

Hong Hanlin, who was walking at the front, said, “Mr. Ye, I’m sorry we’re late.”

Ye Xiu smiled and said, “You’re Mr. Hong, right? I appreciate you coming to the airport despite your busy schedule. Besides, we just arrived.”

Ye Xiu’s tone was not this friendly the last time he was at Modu Airport.

After all, with his status, there was indeed no need for him to be polite.

Today, he was calm when facing Hong Hanlin. It was all because Lin Fan was from Jiang Province.

“It’s only right!” Hong Hanlin hurriedly said. “It’s rare for Jiang Province to welcome you and so many outstanding entrepreneurs. Of course, we have to come and welcome you ourselves.

“Mr. Ye, you must be tired from traveling. Why don’t I arrange for you to have a good rest in the hotel?”

Ye Xiu waved his hand. “We’ve been resting on the plane, so we won’t be resting for the time being.”

The last time he went to Modu, he was suffering from several illnesses and was very weak. Even then, he did not rest immediately.

Instead, he went to see Lin Fan.

Now that Ye Xiu’s body had completely recovered, he definitely would not rest.

Recovered?

That was right!

He had fully recovered!

After Ye Xiu drank the Medical Water, he felt that his illness had completely disappeared.

After a detailed examination at the hospital, this was confirmed.

Because of this, Lin Fan was no longer just a direct descendant of the Qing Hong Sect’s patriarch in Ye Xiu’s heart; he was the current master of the Qing Hong Sect and his savior!

“But if it’s convenient for you, you can send us to Jiangbei University.”

“It’s convenient!” Hong Hanlin hurriedly said.

Following that, Ye Xiu and the many chairmen present were all invited into the Audis and Jeeps.

After that, they continued to make their way to Jiangbei University.

…

At this moment, in Lecture Hall 3 of Jiangbei University…

There were dozens of entrepreneurs, as well as some heads and leaders of various departments of Jiangbei University, present.

Many entrepreneurs walked onto the stage and shared information about the company they worked for, as well as the positions and number of people they would be hiring.

When a round-faced man walked down the stage, Zheng Cong tidied his clothes and slowly walked up.

He turned on the mike he had prepared beforehand and said, “Good morning, teachers, leaders, and entrepreneurs of Jiangbei University!

“I’m Zheng Cong, the human resources director of Huidong Accounting Firm. Huidong Accounting Firm is one of the top ten largest accounting firms in the country. We serve a wide range of listed companies and have more than 5,000 employees in the country…

“In Huidong Accounting Firm, we have two paths of development.

“Firstly, there’s the accounting analyst route. The levels for accountants are one-star, two-star, three-star, four-star, five-star…

“Secondly, there’s the management path. It’s split into Level P1, Level P2, Level P3, Level P4, Level P5…”

“The benefits of P1 and one-star are the same… The annual salary of P1s and one-stars is 300,000 yuan, the annual salary of P2s and two-stars is 500,000 yuan, and after reaching P3 and three-star, the annual salary is 800,000 yuan. At the same time, employees will receive the company’s stock incentive!

“P4s and four-stars have an annual salary of more than 1.5 million yuan and a high stock incentive! Oh right, my position as the human resources director is at P4.

“Also, I have something to tell the teachers and professors here. I’m a student who graduated from Jiangbei University.

“I joined Huidong Accounting Firm five years ago and started as an intern. In a short five years, I became the HR director, a P4-level position.

“So, what I want to say is that as long as my juniors are willing to come to Huidong Accounting Firm, they’ll definitely have a bright future!

“We all come from the same educational background. If I can do it, you can definitely do it too!”
